title: Bumble Announces Two New Features For Confidence and Clarity in Dating
summary: AUSTIN, Texas - February 26, 2026 - Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL) today announced two new features designed to help our community move from matching to meaningful connection with greater confidence and clarity. The first, AI-suggested Profile Guidance , is a comprehensive profile enhancement rolling out globally. It delivers personalized, actionable feedback on your bio and prompts as you build your profile, guiding members step by step to help truly reflect who they are. The impact of having a strong Bumble profile is clear: bios that are conversational, humorous, or spark curiosity outperform generic ones. The data backs it up, with nearly 60% of members with strong bios seeing higher engagement in mutual conversations. Additionally, women with two to three prompts received one-third more responses to their messages compared to those with none.
